headline: Payhawk raised $280 million in a Series C round led by Goldman Sachs Alternatives
body: Payhawk raised $280 million in a Series C round led by Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, the company said in a press release on Wednesday. The round values Payhawk at $2 billion, and its total funding is more than $515 million. Payhawk says it will keep building a finance operating system around AI agents, payments and enterprise controls.
note: The release says the controls decide whether an agent or a human makes a decision, which is where spend management and agent payments meet.

figure.label: Series C round, per Payhawk's press release

evidence.text: Payhawk raised $280 million in a Series C funding round to fuel its effort to move beyond expense management and build a financial operating system that brings together artificial intelligence agents, payments and enterprise controls, the company said in a Wednesday (Nov. 18) press release.
The round values Payhawk at $2 billion and brings the company’s total funding to more than $515 million, according to the release.
Payhawk’s Series C round was led by Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives .

With the new capital, Payhawk will continue building its Finance Operating System around AI agents that perform financial work; payments infrastructure that allows agents to safely interact with money; and enterprise controls that determine whether a decision can be made by an agent or requires a human, per the release.
